title: The Fast Fourier Transform in Fourier Spectroscopy
lineage: July 1966 Goddard report credits Cooley and Tukey, explains the use of Cooley’s FORTRAN IV program, and separately reports FFT implementation in the IRIS experiment data-reduction and simulation programs. The passage does not identify the IRIS implementation as that specific program; exact implementation date and flight use are not established.
